summary: Feed s185_triple is degraded: 100% VLAN tags stripped (VLANs 10,20 missing), 17.5% one-way TCP sessions, and microbursts to 1.53 Gbps overload 1 Gbps IDS port.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags - all packets arrive untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are never seen. Common when broker port is set to strip tags or SPAN destination removes tags by default.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot apply VLAN-aware policies or segment detection for VLANs 10,20; traffic from those segments is invisible or misclassified, creating blind spots and missed lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end through TAP and packet broker so IDS receives VLANs 10,20 intact for correct filtering and detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Only one direction of TCP sessions is delivered to this IDS - 22 of 126 sessions (17.5%) are unidirectional. Likely asymmetric routing with single-sided SPAN/TAP or broker aggregation/load-balancing hashing that splits client->server and server->client to different tool ports.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions for TCP reassembly and state tracking. One-way visibility breaks stream reassembly, causes missed exploits, evasion, and high false negatives on this IDS.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow and use symmetric hashing to guarantee client and server packets of same session go to same IDS port.

findings.root_cause: Microbursts peak at 1.53 Gbps in 1ms intervals vs 1 Gbps IDS port capacity (153% overload, 4 intervals). Broker is forwarding line-rate bursts without shaping or load-balancing, overrunning the tool's ingress buffer.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS will drop packets during bursts due to port overrun - exactly when attack traffic may hide. Results in incomplete captures, missed signatures, and degraded detection during peak load.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2+ IDS ports with symmetric load balancing or add burst buffering/shaping to keep per-port rate <80% of 1 Gbps and prevent drops while preserving full payload for IDS.
